<!--
  UI Macro: illumio_label_condition_builder

  Replacement authoring UI for label_condition_custom.

  It renders OR clauses of "dimension is value" rows (AND within a clause, OR between clauses),
  which is the DNF shape the evaluator already consumes.

  STORAGE. The field holds a ServiceNow encoded query in exactly one canonical shape:

    illumio_label_dimension.key=env^cmdb_value=qa^NQillumio_label_dimension.key=os^cmdb_value=linux

  Clauses joined by ^NQ, conditions within a clause joined by ^, always a dimension token
  immediately followed by its value token. IllumioSyncUtils.parseLabelCondition already consumes
  this: isDimensionCondition explicitly accepts the illumio_label_dimension.key dot-walk, so no
  server-side parser is needed for this pass.

  The dot-walk is what lets a raw typed dimension NAME be stored correctly without a GlideAjax
  round trip to resolve it to a sys_id. It is not free: a dot-walked predicate cannot use the
  composite index on (illumio_pce_configuration, class_mapping, illumio_label_dimension,
  cmdb_value), because the predicate lands on the joined table rather than the indexed one. That
  costs nothing today, since nothing evaluates this field yet. Before anything does, either resolve
  name to sys_id once per run and rewrite the token, or land the dimension picker so the sys_id
  form is written directly. Both shapes parse, so neither needs a migration.

  Filtering behaviour is deliberately untouched. label_condition is still what the evaluator reads.

  Dimension and value are raw text inputs on purpose. A dimension picker needs a GlideAjax
  round trip, which is deferred.

  Shown on edit only. On a new record there is no saved condition to author against, and the
  author has not yet chosen the PCE Configuration a dimension would be validated against.

  MARKUP. Every class and every column width below was lifted from the rendered DOM of the
  stock label_condition field on this same form. That is why there is almost no CSS here: the
  platform already styles filerTable, sn-filter-clause, sn-filter-section-message,
  condition-row__*-cell, filerTableInput, filerTableAction and deleteButton, and it restyles
  them for whichever theme is active. Do not substitute hand-written layout for these; the two
  previous revisions did and sat misaligned against the real builder directly below.

  In particular the label column is col-xs-12 col-md-1_5 col-lg-2 and the field column is
  col-xs-10 col-md-9 col-lg-8. Those are not the Bootstrap defaults. col-md-1_5 is a
  ServiceNow half-step column and has no standard equivalent.

  NO COLOURS. Nothing here declares one. An early revision hardcoded hex and rendered white
  panels on a dark theme.

  Install:
    1. UI Macro named illumio_label_condition_builder, this file as the XML.
    2. Formatter (sys_ui_formatter): Name "Label Condition Builder",
       Formatter "illumio_label_condition_builder", Table x_illu2_illumio_illumio_sync_filter.
    3. Form Design on Sync Filter: add that formatter where the builder should appear.
    4. REQUIRED NOW THAT THIS READS AND WRITES: label_condition_custom must be ON the form and
       hidden with a UI Policy, not left off the layout. g_form.getValue and g_form.setValue on a
       field that is not on the form are silent no-ops, which we have already been bitten by once
       on this form. The symptom would be a builder that always opens empty and never saves.
-->
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">

    <!--
      String comparison rather than a raw boolean. Jelly's handling of booleans returned from
      g:evaluate is inconsistent across phases; 'yes'/'no' behaves the same everywhere.
    -->
    <g2:evaluate var="jvar_illumio_lcb_new"
                 expression="current.isNewRecord() ? 'yes' : 'no'" />

    <j2:if test="$[jvar_illumio_lcb_new == 'no']">

        <!--
          Static markup is plain divs only. No table and no style element.

          The formatter pipeline relocates both: an earlier revision declared the filerTable
          here, inside the field column, and it was rendered as a SIBLING of the form group
          instead, outside the column layout. The style element came back wrapped in a table
          of its own. Everything structural is therefore created in JavaScript below, after
          the page has parsed, where nothing rewrites it.

          There is also no form-group wrapper here. The formatter already emits one:
          div.custom-form-group.is-wide.form-group. Adding another nests two.
        -->
        <div data-type="label" class="label_left">
            <label class="col-xs-12 col-md-1_5 col-lg-2 control-label">
                <span class="label-text">Label Condition (new)</span>
            </label>
        </div>

        <div class="col-xs-10 col-md-9 col-lg-8 form-field input_controls"
             id="illumio_lcb_field"></div>

        <!-- The field column floats. Without this the next field rides up alongside. -->
        <div style="clear: both;"></div>

        <script>
            <![CDATA[
            (function buildIllumioLabelConditionBuilder() {

                var fieldEl = document.getElementById('illumio_lcb_field');
                if (!fieldEl) {
                    return;
                }

                // Assigned during assembly at the bottom of this function, before anything
                // that reads it runs.
                var clausesBody = null;

                // False until g_form has been seen. Every write is suppressed while it is
                // false, so a builder that loads before the form model exists renders and
                // stays inert rather than writing an empty string over a saved condition.
                var formReady = false;

                var FIRST_CLAUSE_TEXT = 'All of these conditions must be met';
                var LATER_CLAUSE_TEXT = 'OR all of these conditions must be met';

                var FIELD_NAME = 'label_condition_custom';

                // The canonical serialized shape. See the STORAGE note in the header comment.
                var DIMENSION_PREFIX = 'illumio_label_dimension.key=';
                var VALUE_PREFIX = 'cmdb_value=';
                var TERM_SEPARATOR = '^NQ';
                var CONDITION_SEPARATOR = '^';

                // g_form is not guaranteed to exist when a formatter's inline script runs.
                // 100 tries at 50ms is 5 seconds, after which we give up and render an empty
                // builder rather than poll forever.
                var FORM_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 50;
                var FORM_POLL_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 100;

                var formPollAttempts = 0;

                /**
                 * forEach over an HTMLCollection rather than an indexed for loop: the loop
                 * condition would need a less-than character, which Jelly rejects before the
                 * browser ever sees this script, CDATA or not. For the same reason no
                 * ampersand appears anywhere below, comments included, and nested ifs stand
                 * in for the logical-and operator.
                 */
                function eachElement(collection, callback) {
                    Array.prototype.forEach.call(collection, callback);
                }

                function makeElement(tag, className, cssText) {
                    var el = document.createElement(tag);
                    if (className) {
                        el.className = className;
                    }
                    if (cssText) {
                        el.style.cssText = cssText;
                    }
                    return el;
                }

                /**
                 * type="button" is not cosmetic. A bare button element inside a ServiceNow
                 * form defaults to type="submit" and saves the record on click.
                 */
                function makeButton(text, className, title, onClick) {
                    var button = makeElement('button', className);
                    button.type = 'button';
                    button.title = title;
                    button.textContent = text;
                    button.onclick = onClick;
                    return button;
                }

                /**
                 * Remove the clause separator from typed text.
                 *
                 * ServiceNow does not escape the separator inside encoded query values, so a
                 * value containing one would split during parsing and silently become two
                 * conditions. splitConditionTerms documents this as unavoidable for the stock
                 * builder, which cannot stop the author typing one. We can: this is the one
                 * correctness win a custom builder gets for free.
                 *
                 * The character is dropped as it is typed, so the author sees it not appear
                 * rather than discovering a mangled condition after a save.
                 */
                function stripSeparator(text) {
                    return ('' + (text || '')).split(CONDITION_SEPARATOR).join('');
                }

                function onInputChanged(input) {
                    var cleaned = stripSeparator(input.value);
                    if (cleaned !== input.value) {
                        input.value = cleaned;
                    }
                    writeField();
                }

                function makeInput(placeholder, cssText, initialValue) {
                    var input = makeElement('input', 'filerTableInput form-control', cssText);
                    input.type = 'text';
                    input.placeholder = placeholder;
                    if (initialValue) {
                        input.value = initialValue;
                    }
                    input.oninput = function () {
                        onInputChanged(input);
                    };
                    return input;
                }

                // ---- serialization ----

                /**
                 * The two text inputs of one condition row, in document order: dimension then
                 * value. Document order is the field cell preceding the value cell in buildRow.
                 */
                function rowInputs(outerRow) {
                    return outerRow.getElementsByTagName('input');
                }

                /**
                 * Every row of the builder as the canonical encoded query.
                 *
                 * A row with both inputs empty is skipped rather than serialized. It is what a
                 * freshly added row looks like before the author types into it, and emitting it
                 * would store a condition that matches nothing. A row with only ONE side filled
                 * IS serialized, so a half-finished condition survives a save and comes back
                 * visible on reload instead of disappearing.
                 */
                function serialize() {
                    var terms = [];

                    eachElement(clausesBody.children, function (wrapperRow) {
                        var conditions = [];

                        eachElement(wrapperRow.querySelectorAll('tr.filter_row'), function (outerRow) {
                            var inputs = rowInputs(outerRow);
                            if (inputs.length !== 2) {
                                return;
                            }

                            var dimension = stripSeparator(inputs[0].value).trim();
                            var value = stripSeparator(inputs[1].value).trim();

                            if (dimension === '') {
                                if (value === '') {
                                    return;
                                }
                            }

                            conditions.push(DIMENSION_PREFIX + dimension);
                            conditions.push(VALUE_PREFIX + value);
                        });

                        if (conditions.length > 0) {
                            terms.push(conditions.join(CONDITION_SEPARATOR));
                        }
                    });

                    return terms.join(TERM_SEPARATOR);
                }

                /**
                 * Push the current state of the builder into the field.
                 *
                 * Called on every keystroke and after every structural change, so the field is
                 * always the truth and the form's own unsaved-changes prompt works on condition
                 * edits without any extra wiring.
                 */
                function writeField() {
                    if (!formReady) {
                        return;
                    }
                    g_form.setValue(FIELD_NAME, serialize());
                }

                // ---- deserialization ----

                /**
                 * Read a stored condition back into clauses of { dimension, value } rows.
                 *
                 * Viewer semantics, not validator semantics: anything unrecognised is dropped
                 * and nothing throws, because the job here is to show the author what is stored
                 * rather than to judge it. Two shapes are tolerated on purpose:
                 *
                 *  - a dimension token with no value token after it renders as a row with an
                 *    empty value input. That is the R19 shape, and showing it is how the author
                 *    finds out it is there.
                 *  - a value token with no dimension ahead of it has no row to belong to and is
                 *    skipped.
                 *
                 * Neither can be produced by this builder. They can only arrive from a value
                 * authored elsewhere.
                 */
                function parseStoredCondition(stored) {
                    var clauses = [];
                    var text = '' + (stored || '');

                    if (text.trim() === '') {
                        return clauses;
                    }

                    eachElement(text.split(TERM_SEPARATOR), function (term) {
                        var rows = [];
                        var pending = null;

                        eachElement(term.split(CONDITION_SEPARATOR), function (token) {
                            if (token === '') {
                                return;
                            }

                            if (token.indexOf(DIMENSION_PREFIX) === 0) {
                                if (pending !== null) {
                                    rows.push(pending);
                                }
                                pending = {
                                    dimension: token.substring(DIMENSION_PREFIX.length),
                                    value: ''
                                };
                                return;
                            }

                            if (token.indexOf(VALUE_PREFIX) === 0) {
                                if (pending === null) {
                                    return;
                                }
                                pending.value = token.substring(VALUE_PREFIX.length);
                                rows.push(pending);
                                pending = null;
                            }
                        });

                        if (pending !== null) {
                            rows.push(pending);
                        }

                        if (rows.length > 0) {
                            clauses.push(rows);
                        }
                    });

                    return clauses;
                }

                // ---- structure ----

                /**
                 * One condition row, wrapped in the nested table the stock builder uses.
                 * The wrapper exists so each row can size its own cells independently, which
                 * is how the real builder keeps ragged rows aligned.
                 */
                function buildRow(dimension, value) {
                    var outerRow = makeElement('tr', 'filter_row');
                    var outerCell = makeElement('td', null, 'width: 100%; padding-bottom: 4px;');
                    var innerTable = makeElement('table');
                    innerTable.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
                    var innerBody = makeElement('tbody');
                    var row = makeElement('tr', 'filter_row_condition', 'display: table;');

                    // Empty in the stock builder too. It reserves the gutter the AND/OR text
                    // occupies on intra-row OR conditions.
                    row.appendChild(makeElement('td',
                        'sn-filter-top condition-row__and-or-text-cell',
                        'text-align: right; min-width: 10px; width: 10px;'));

                    var fieldCell = makeElement('td', 'sn-filter-top condition-row__field-cell');
                    fieldCell.appendChild(
                        makeInput('Label dimension', 'width: 250px; vertical-align: top;', dimension));
                    row.appendChild(fieldCell);

                    // A disabled single-option select rather than plain text. It holds the
                    // same column width as the stock operator dropdown so the two builders
                    // line up, and being greyed out is what tells the author the operator is
                    // fixed rather than merely unset.
                    var operatorCell = makeElement('td',
                        'sn-filter-top condition-row__operator-cell', 'width: auto;');
                    var operator = makeElement('select',
                        'filerTableSelect form-control condOperator',
                        'width: 150px; vertical-align: top;');
                    operator.disabled = true;
                    var isOption = document.createElement('option');
                    isOption.textContent = 'is';
                    operator.appendChild(isOption);
                    operatorCell.appendChild(operator);
                    row.appendChild(operatorCell);

                    var valueCell = makeElement('td',
                        'sn-filter-top form-inline condition-row__value-cell');
                    valueCell.appendChild(makeInput('Value', 'vertical-align: top;', value));
                    row.appendChild(valueCell);

                    var buttonsCell = makeElement('td',
                        'sn-filter-top condition_buttons_cell', 'white-space: nowrap;');
                    buttonsCell.appendChild(makeButton('AND', 'btn btn-default filerTableAction',
                        'Add AND condition', function () {
                            addRowAfter(outerRow);
                        }));
                    buttonsCell.appendChild(makeButton('OR', 'btn btn-default filerTableAction',
                        'Add OR condition', function () {
                            addClause();
                        }));
                    row.appendChild(buttonsCell);

                    var removeCell = makeElement('td',
                        'sn-filter-top condition-row__remove-cell');
                    var removeButton = makeButton('', 'filerTableAction btn btn-default deleteButton',
                        'Delete', function () {
                            removeRow(outerRow);
                        });
                    removeButton.appendChild(makeElement('span', 'icon-cross'));
                    removeCell.appendChild(removeButton);
                    row.appendChild(removeCell);

                    innerBody.appendChild(row);
                    innerTable.appendChild(innerBody);
                    outerCell.appendChild(innerTable);
                    outerRow.appendChild(outerCell);

                    return outerRow;
                }

                /**
                 * One OR clause: a divider, a wording line, then its condition rows. The
                 * divider is hidden on the first clause rather than omitted, which is what
                 * the stock builder does, so relabelling never has to add or remove nodes.
                 *
                 * `rows` comes from parseStoredCondition when a saved condition is being
                 * rendered. Omitted, the clause opens with one empty row.
                 */
                function buildClause(rows) {
                    var wrapperRow = makeElement('tr');
                    var wrapperCell = makeElement('td', null,
                        'vertical-align: top; width: 100%;');
                    // Both classes, not just the first. The stock builder always emits
                    // "sn-filter-clause sn-animate-filter-clause" together, and a clause
                    // carrying only sn-filter-clause renders into the DOM but stays
                    // invisible: the animate class is what brings it in.
                    var clauseTable = makeElement('table',
                        'sn-filter-clause sn-animate-filter-clause');
                    clauseTable.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
                    var clauseBody = makeElement('tbody');

                    var dividerRow = makeElement('tr', 'illumio-lcb-divider');
                    var dividerCell = makeElement('td',
                        'sn-filter-top sn_multiple_conditions');
                    dividerCell.appendChild(makeElement('hr'));
                    dividerRow.appendChild(dividerCell);
                    dividerRow.appendChild(makeElement('td'));
                    clauseBody.appendChild(dividerRow);

                    var messageRow = makeElement('tr', 'sn-filter-section-message');
                    var messageCell = makeElement('td', 'sn-filter-top');
                    messageCell.appendChild(makeElement('h3', 'small'));
                    messageRow.appendChild(messageCell);
                    clauseBody.appendChild(messageRow);

                    var initialRows = rows ? rows : [{ dimension: '', value: '' }];
                    eachElement(initialRows, function (initialRow) {
                        clauseBody.appendChild(
                            buildRow(initialRow.dimension, initialRow.value));
                    });

                    clauseTable.appendChild(clauseBody);
                    wrapperCell.appendChild(clauseTable);
                    wrapperRow.appendChild(wrapperCell);

                    return wrapperRow;
                }

                function addClause() {
                    clausesBody.appendChild(buildClause());
                    relabelClauses();
                    writeField();
                }

                function addRowAfter(outerRow) {
                    var clauseBody = outerRow.parentNode;
                    clauseBody.insertBefore(buildRow(), outerRow.nextSibling);
                    writeField();
                }

                function addRowToLastClause() {
                    var clauses = clausesBody.children;
                    if (clauses.length === 0) {
                        addClause();
                        return;
                    }

                    clauses[clauses.length - 1]
                        .querySelector('tbody')
                        .appendChild(buildRow());
                    writeField();
                }

                function removeRow(outerRow) {
                    var clauseBody = outerRow.parentNode;
                    clauseBody.removeChild(outerRow);

                    // A clause with no rows matches everything, which is never what the
                    // author meant. Drop the clause rather than leave a heading behind.
                    if (clauseBody.querySelectorAll('tr.filter_row').length === 0) {
                        removeClause(clauseBody);
                        return;
                    }

                    writeField();
                }

                function removeClause(clauseBody) {
                    // tbody to table to td to tr, which is the node sitting in clausesBody.
                    var wrapperRow = clauseBody.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;
                    if (wrapperRow.parentNode) {
                        wrapperRow.parentNode.removeChild(wrapperRow);
                    }

                    // Never leave the author with nothing to type into. addClause relabels
                    // and writes on its own.
                    if (clausesBody.children.length === 0) {
                        addClause();
                        return;
                    }

                    relabelClauses();
                    writeField();
                }

                function relabelClauses() {
                    eachElement(clausesBody.children, function (wrapperRow, index) {
                        var clauseBody = wrapperRow.querySelector('tbody');

                        clauseBody.querySelector('h3.small').textContent =
                            index === 0 ? FIRST_CLAUSE_TEXT : LATER_CLAUSE_TEXT;

                        clauseBody.querySelector('tr.illumio-lcb-divider').style.display =
                            index === 0 ? 'none' : '';
                    });
                }

                // ---- load ----

                /**
                 * A formatter's inline script can run before the form model exists, so g_form
                 * is polled rather than assumed. The callback is told whether it appeared.
                 */
                function whenFormReady(callback) {
                    var ready = false;
                    if (typeof g_form !== 'undefined') {
                        if (g_form) {
                            if (typeof g_form.getValue === 'function') {
                                ready = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (ready) {
                        callback(true);
                        return;
                    }

                    formPollAttempts = formPollAttempts + 1;
                    if (formPollAttempts > FORM_POLL_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
                        callback(false);
                        return;
                    }

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        whenFormReady(callback);
                    }, FORM_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
                }

                /**
                 * Render whatever is stored, or one empty clause when there is nothing.
                 *
                 * No write happens here. Rendering a saved condition must not mark the form
                 * dirty, and re-serializing on load would do exactly that on any value this
                 * builder did not itself produce.
                 */
                function renderStoredCondition() {
                    var clauses = formReady ?
                        parseStoredCondition(g_form.getValue(FIELD_NAME)) : [];

                    if (clauses.length === 0) {
                        clausesBody.appendChild(buildClause());
                        relabelClauses();
                        return;
                    }

                    eachElement(clauses, function (rows) {
                        clausesBody.appendChild(buildClause(rows));
                    });
                    relabelClauses();
                }

                // ---- assembly ----
                //
                // Built here rather than declared in the macro markup. See the comment on the
                // static markup above: a table declared there does not survive the formatter.

                var actions = makeElement('div', 'filter-row');
                actions.appendChild(makeButton('Add Filter Condition',
                    'btn btn-default filerTableAction',
                    'Add another condition that must be true', addRowToLastClause));
                actions.appendChild(makeButton('Add OR Clause',
                    'btn btn-default filerTableAction',
                    'Add another condition that may be true', addClause));
                fieldEl.appendChild(actions);

                var filterTable = makeElement('table', 'filerTable');
                filterTable.setAttribute('cellspacing', '0');
                filterTable.setAttribute('cellpadding', '1');
                filterTable.setAttribute('border', '0');

                clausesBody = makeElement('tbody', 'sn-filter-multi-clause');
                filterTable.appendChild(clausesBody);
                fieldEl.appendChild(filterTable);

                // Nothing is rendered until g_form resolves, so a saved condition paints once
                // rather than appearing as an empty clause that is then replaced.
                whenFormReady(function (ready) {
                    formReady = ready;
                    renderStoredCondition();
                });

            })();
            ]]>
        </script>

    </j2:if>

</j:jelly>
</xml></sys_ui_macro></record_update>
